blocks.content: Course: CSS Fundamentals for Your First Webpage
Before writing responsive CSS, developers make one mindset shift:

items: Mobile screens are the most constrained.
Desktop layouts are easier to scale up.

Personally, what I say to Junior developers regarding this is, a mobile first layout will still be working on bigger screens even if it looks small but a desktop first design will surely break on small devices if not written properly.

blocks.content: In modern frontend work, mobile is not an afterthought — it's the baseline.
Your blog already does this by default — that's a good thing.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
